cases.answer:
Decision: hand off original Conduit files as separate unaltered layers on the dark field. Do not redraw marks, recolor, or present a Conduit–Hyatt partnership.

Facts: No Hyatt logo is in this library. Dark-background Conduit originals are the pale transparent 512px website icon (asset_b8d066fe19fbc0e24e47) and the official dark wordmark SVG (asset_761b0b47f1b7c604d186). The site’s white wordmark is an observed footer CSS treatment (brightness(0) invert(1)), not a downloaded white master. Opaque site/touch tiles and the Brandfetch JPEG must not replace the transparent icon. Assets are not campaign-approved.

Proposal: place the original pale icon unchanged. Use the original SVG with the recorded invert only if export preserves it; otherwise wait for a reverse master. Align optical height; clear-space is unpublished.

Unavailable: verified Hyatt logo; reverse wordmark master; campaign approval; confirmed spacing, palette roles, and font permissions.

assessment.reason: Initial answer selected the safe original icon but underused the observed white-wordmark treatment. Structured asset context was improved; the focused retest names the exact SVG treatment, export dependency and missing Hyatt master.

assessment: Model answers from deliberately selected document bundles. Parent-agent assessment follows; not human approval or a general retrieval benchmark.
